facts.fact: The finance minister says the Espace du contribuable platform lets taxpayers make declarations and tax procedures and pay electronically at a distance.
The finance minister says more than 500 taxpayers joined the DGI electronic platform, which contributed to collecting 36.45% of the directorate's revenue in 2026.
The DGI director general says 53 public entities file declarations electronically while no more than three pay their taxes through the platform.
